title: Annotation Shortcuts in Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection: code and aggregated results
description:
Analysis code, frozen configurations and aggregated results for the study Annotation Shortcuts in Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection: An Audit of PROCESS-2 and an Interpretable Annotation-Free Baseline.

The study audits the PROCESS-2 corpus and shows that timed pause annotations follow two transcription conventions whose use depends on diagnosis, that supervised text classifiers exploit them (mainly through timed pauses and a timer marker), and that an interpretable model built without any human annotation reaches a test AUC of 0.81.

No participant data are included: PROCESS-2 is distributed by its authors under a data use agreement.
